pairs.name: box-blur
pairs.alt: The rainy night street with neon signs, original left and with Box Blur at Radius 16 right: the signs, windows and the walker dissolve into soft blocks of colour, and small lights turn into flat squares instead of round glows
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Radius 16.

pairs.name: gaussian-blur
pairs.alt: The harbour town, original left and with Gaussian Blur at Radius 12 right: boats, houses and the mountain go soft and their edges melt into the sky and the water
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Radius 12.

pairs.name: motion-blur
pairs.alt: The dancer on the dark stage, original left and with Motion Blur at Length 2% right: her body, arms and dress smear sideways into soft streaks, as if she rushed across the stage while the shutter was open
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Length 2%.

pairs.name: radial-blur
pairs.alt: The dancer on the dark stage, original left and with Radial Blur in Spin mode at Amount 0.5 right: her arms, dress and the stage floor smear in arcs around her middle, as if she spun in a pirouette while the shutter was open
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Type Spin, Amount 0.5.

pairs.name: zoom-blur
pairs.alt: The rainy night street, original left and with Zoom Blur at Amount 0.3 right: the neon signs, shop fronts and wet reflections streak outward from the walker in the middle, as if the camera rushed down the street while the shutter was open
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Amount 0.3.
